answer.text: The NZ-SOUTH sales guide says to bundle Climbing and Safety Equipment with fitting and inspection advice for tourism operators. Their main buying peak is summer (December–February) for Camping, Hiking and Climbing, so line up bundles before then. Operators often ask for deeper discounts before summer. Stay within the 15% cap, use the Discount Approval Process, and offer volume terms instead. Stock ships from Christchurch, and Queenstown deliveries take two days.
